comments.author: @ashwilliams7302
comments.text: 5 years later and there still hasn't been a better show than this

comments.author: @Creasy5678
comments.text:
One of the few film spinoffs that nailed the feel of the films. It was weird to see Ash 30 years later, pushing 60, getting old and fat with false teeth and a young adult kid, but Bruce Campbell sold it. Also, the way he drunkenly restarted the whole thing after guarding the book for 30 years trying to get some? So an Ash moment.

Sad thing is, with this done, Campbell has said he won't be returning as Ash for film or tv. The remake? The only good thing was the few-second glimpse of the old Ash going "Groovy!" to me.

End of an era.
